title: Cute!
text: Cute!. I'm on my way to being a crazy cat lady, so why not put a cat towel in my bathroom! This towel is really cute. I have it hanging on a towel ring in my guest bath. It's kind of thin, but it seems to dry quickly and absorb well. There are snaps so you can put the cat's paws around the rack to secure it and keep it from falling.
